mount.eternalrealm.talent.great_leap.des.ja: 4ブロック近くを跳び越える

mount.eternalrealm.talent.wave_runner.de.ja: 静かな水の上を全速で駆け、水の中でも呼べる
mount.eternalrealm.talent.wave_runner.de.en: Gallops over still water at full speed and can be called in water

mount.eternalrealm.talent.glide.desc.ja: 空中でジャンプを押し続けると翼を広げてゆっくり降りる
mount.eternalrealm.talent.glide.desc.en: Hold Jump in the air to spread its wings and glide down

mount.eternalrealm.talent.surge.desc.ja: 全力で2秒駆けると燃え上がり、さらに12%速くなる
mount.eternalrealm.talent.surge.desc.en: After two seconds at full gallop it flares up and runs 12% faster

mount.eternalrealm.talent.sky_step.desc.ja: 空中でもう一度ジャンプできる（着地まで1回）
mount.eternalrealm.talent.sky_step.desc.en: Jumps once more in mid-air (once until it lands)

mount.eternalrealm.talent.land_strider.d.ja: 地上でも飛ぶのに近い速さで走る
mount.eternalrealm.talent.land_strider.d.en: Runs on the ground nearly as fast as it flies

mount.eternalrealm.talent.hover.desc.ja: 何もしなければ空中にとどまる。羽音を立てない
mount.eternalrealm.talent.hover.desc.en: Stays put in the air when let go; its wings make no sound

mount.eternalrealm.talent.dive.desc.ja: スニークで鋭く急降下し、降りながら25%速くなる
mount.eternalrealm.talent.dive.desc.en: Sneak to dive steeply, 25% faster while diving

mount.eternalrealm.talent.high_flight.de.ja: ほかより16ブロック高く飛べる
mount.eternalrealm.talent.high_flight.de.en: Flies 16 blocks higher than the others

mount.eternalrealm.talent.updraft.desc.ja: 地上から一気に飛び立ち、速く上昇する
mount.eternalrealm.talent.updraft.desc.en: Shoots up from the ground and climbs fast

mount.eternalrealm.horse_bloom.desc.ja: 花咲く枝角と若葉のたてがみをもつ、鹿のように身軽な森の馬
mount.eternalrealm.horse_bloom.desc.en: A deer-light forest horse with antlers in bloom and a mane of leaves

mount.eternalrealm.horse_tide.desc.ja: ひれの冠と波しぶきのたてがみをもつ、海の馬
mount.eternalrealm.horse_tide.desc.en: A sea horse with a fin crest and a mane of sea foam

mount.eternalrealm.horse_gale.desc.ja: 肩に翼をたたむ駿馬。翼を広げて高みから舞い降りる
mount.eternalrealm.horse_gale.desc.en: A courser with wings folded at its shoulders; it spreads them to glide down from heights

mount.eternalrealm.horse_blaze.desc.ja: 溶岩の筋が走る体に炎のたてがみ。駆けるほど燃え上がる
mount.eternalrealm.horse_blaze.desc.en: A horse veined with lava and maned in fire; the longer it runs, the hotter it burns

mount.eternalrealm.horse_halo.desc.ja: 螺旋の角と光輪、光のたてがみをもつ純白の聖馬
mount.eternalrealm.horse_halo.desc.en: A pearl-white steed with a spiral horn, a halo and a mane of light

mount.eternalrealm.griffin_gold.desc.ja: 鷲の頭と獅子の体。たてがみをなびかせて地を駆ける
mount.eternalrealm.griffin_gold.desc.en: An eagle's head on a lion's body; it runs the land with its mane flying

mount.eternalrealm.griffin_owl.desc.ja: 大きな目の梟の顔。音もなく空にとどまる
mount.eternalrealm.griffin_owl.desc.en: Owl-faced with great eyes; it hangs silent in the air

mount.eternalrealm.griffin_storm.desc.ja: 稲妻の走る長い翼。雷のように急降下する
mount.eternalrealm.griffin_storm.desc.en: Long wings veined with lightning; it dives like a thunderbolt

mount.eternalrealm.griffin_frost.desc.ja: 氷の冠と結晶の羽先。ほかよりも高い空を飛ぶ
mount.eternalrealm.griffin_frost.desc.en: Crowned in ice, its feathers tipped with crystal; it flies higher than the others

mount.eternalrealm.griffin_void.desc.ja: 星をまとう夜空の翼と、まわりをめぐる三つの結晶。最も速く飛ぶ
mount.eternalrealm.griffin_void.desc.en: Night-sky wings strewn with stars and three circling crystals; the fastest flier
